name: doc-pipeline-chain
description: Documentation pipeline: preflight → rescan → deep-sweep → validate → publish

config.task: Set up .workspace/ with code/, docs/, agent-findings/. Write sweep-manifest.json listing 2 pages with source classes. Write 2 simulated Apex classes in code/ and 2 doc pages in docs/ with SOME intentional stale claims (docs say X but code does Y). Write .workspace/pipeline-state.json with stage=preflight-complete. Call report_complete with setup summary.

Read .workspace/agent-findings/sweep-manifest.json. For each page read the source code and the doc. Find every claim that contradicts the code (code is ALWAYS the truth). Fix doc pages to match code exactly. Tag code refs with data-ref attributes. Write .workspace/agent-findings/rescan-report.md. Update pipeline-state.json: stage=rescan-complete. Call report_complete with your findings.

Read .workspace/pipeline-state.json and sweep-manifest.json. Find pages with low data-ref density. Read source files LINE BY LINE — find methods/branches/error-paths not documented. Expand each thin page to 2-3x data-ref density. Write .workspace/agent-findings/deep-sweep-report.md. Update pipeline-state: stage=deep-sweep-complete. Call report_complete.

Run 3 validation passes max. Each pass: extract every factual claim from docs in .workspace/docs/, verify each against .workspace/code/ source files. Fix mismatches immediately. Stop when zero mismatches or after 3 passes. Write pass reports to .workspace/agent-findings/validation-pass-N.md. Update pipeline-state: result=clean or needs-human with pass count. Call report_complete with validation results.

Read pipeline-state.json. Merge validated content into release-branch. Build changelog from agent-findings/*.md reports. Write PR body to .workspace/pr-body.md. Write final summary to .workspace/PIPELINE-COMPLETE.md. Update pipeline-state: stage=publish-complete. Call report_complete with changelog summary.

config.message: Doc pipeline chain finished — PR ready
